gurmukhi: ਤਪਤਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥
romanization: tapat maahi thaadh varataaee ||
english_translation: In the midst of the burning heat, a cooling breeze has begun to blow.

gurmukhi: ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
romanization: taatee vau na lagee paarabraham saranaaee ||
english_translation: The hot wind does not even touch one who is under the Protection of the Supreme Lord God.

gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਭਉ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
romanization: nirabhau japai sagal bhau mitai ||
english_translation: Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear departs.

gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਨੋ ਜੋਗੁ ਕੀਤੋਈ ॥
romanization: tera keeta jaato naahee maino jog keetoee ||
english_translation: I have not appreciated what You have done for me; You have made me worthy.

gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
romanization: too mera pita toohai mera maata ||
english_translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਾਮਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
romanization: dheeraj dhaam bhe kirapaala ||
english_translation: The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the home of patience.

gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
romanization: dukh bhanjan tera naam jee dukh bhanjan tera naam ||
english_translation: The Destroyer of Suffering is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of Suffering is Your Name.

gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
romanization: bhoolee maarag jin bataaia ||
english_translation: One who has shown the way to the one who had forgotten it.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ਸੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
romanization: sukhamanee sukh amrit prabh naam ||
english_translation: Sukhmani: The Jewel of Peace, the Nectar-Name of God.

gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
romanization: houmai maar gur sabad veecharee ||
english_translation: Ego is stilled by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੈ ਖਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥
romanization: je ko bahai khalaaia raam naam chit na aavee ||
english_translation: Even if someone is slandered, but if God's Name does not leave the heart...

gurmukhi: ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
romanization: sagala rog mitaaia karate ||
english_translation: The Creator has cured all diseases and sorrows.

gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
romanization: mere maadhau jee satasangat mile su taria ||
english_translation: O my Dear Lord, one who joins the Sat Sangat (True Congregation) is saved.

gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
romanization: vich duneeaa sev kamaaeeai || taa dargah baisan paaeeai ||
english_translation: In the midst of this world, do service, and you shall be given a place of honor in the Divine Court.

gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਤੂੰ ਕਮਾਵਦਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭੁੰਚੁ ॥
romanization: udam karediaa jeeu too kamaavadiaa sukh bhunch ||
english_translation: While making the effort, you shall live; while practicing it, you shall enjoy peace.

gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ਤਾ ਭਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਕਾੜਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
romanization: too mera raakhaa sabhanee thaaee taa bhau kehaa kaaraa jeeu ||
english_translation: You are my Protector everywhere, so why should I feel any fear or anxiety?

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਖੁ ਅਖਾਏ ਸੁ ਭਲਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
romanization: gur satgur kaa jo sikh akhaae su bhalake uth har naam dhiaavai ||
english_translation: One who calls himself a Sikh of the Guru shall rise early and meditate on the Lord's Name.

gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
romanization: hoi ekatram milhu mere bhaaee durbidhaa door karahu liv laai ||
english_translation: Come and meet together, O my siblings of Destiny; dispel your duality and focus your love on the Lord.

gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
romanization: jeevan maran sabh terai haath ||
english_translation: Life and death are both in Your Hands.

gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਬਰਦਾਤਾ ॥
romanization: ek man purakh dhiaai baradaataa ||
english_translation: With single-minded focus, meditate on the Giver of Blessings.

gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹਛੰਦਾ ॥
romanization: jaa too merai val hai taa kiaa muhachhandaa ||
english_translation: When You are on my side, what do I need from anyone else?

gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
romanization: sadaa sadaa sukh paaiaa raamu naamu gun gaai ||
english_translation: Forever and ever, peace is found by singing the Glories of the Lord's Name.

gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
romanization: man too jot saroop hai aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
english_translation: O my mind, you are the embodiment of Divine Light; recognize your own origin.

gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
romanization: aaj kaal fun kaal karatiaa janamgaiaa ||
english_translation: Thinking of today and tomorrow, and then the day after, life passes away.

gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਚੀਤ ॥
romanization: par kaa buraa na raakhahu cheet ||
english_translation: Do not cherish ill-will for others in your mind.

gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਉ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
romanization: sagalee rain suhaavanee jau pir rahai hadoor ||
english_translation: The entire night is beautiful, if the Beloved remains close by.

gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਊ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
romanization: bin santokh nahee kooo raajai ||
english_translation: Without contentment, no one is ever satisfied.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਗਉੜਾ ਤਿਥੈ ਤੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥
romanization: jithai gauraa tithai too rakhavaalaa ||
english_translation: Where the path is difficult, there You are my Protector.

gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਜਾਨਤ ॥
romanization: ghat ghat ke antar kee jaanat ||
english_translation: He knows the inner state of every heart.

gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਹੋਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
romanization: keetaa hoaa hovanahaar ||
english_translation: Whatever has been done, and whatever is to happen (is in Hukam).

gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਵੈਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਰਚਾਇਦਾ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
romanization: niravairai naal vair rchaaidaa apanai ghar lookee laai ||
english_translation: One who harbors enmity against the one who is without enmity, sets fire to his own home.

gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
romanization: jin disai gurasikharaa tis niv niv laagau paai ||
english_translation: Whenever I see a Sikh of the Guru, I bow down and touch their feet.

gurmukhi: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
romanization: rog gayaa prabh aap gavaaiaa ||
english_translation: The disease is split; God Himself has cured it.

gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਗਾਲੈ ॥
romanization: kaam krodh kaaiaa kau gaalai ||
english_translation: Lust and anger consume the body.

gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਧਨਿ ਖਾਟੇ ॥
romanization: sukh naahee bahutai dhan khaate ||
english_translation: There is no peace in earning a great deal of wealth (without content).

gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
romanization: darasan dekh jeevaa gur teraa ||
english_translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live.

gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਖੇਲਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥ ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਤਲੀ ਗਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਉ ॥
romanization: jau tau prem khelran kaa chaau || sir dhar talee galee meree aau ||
english_translation: If you desire to play the game of love, then step onto My path with your head upon your palm.

gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਵਿਸਰਾਮ ਹੋਆ ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
romanization: man visaraam hoaa tau sukh paaiaa ||
english_translation: When the mind rests in peace, then happiness is found.

gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
romanization: nirabhau jeevahi har ke daas ||
english_translation: The servants of the Lord live without fear.

gurmukhi: ਉਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
romanization: uthat baithat sovat dhiaaeeai ||
english_translation: While standing, sitting and sleeping, meditate on Him.

gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
romanization: toon samarath saran ko daata ||
english_translation: You are the All-powerful Provider of Shelter.

gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਚਾਹਉ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਾਰੇ ॥
romanization: raaj na chaahau mukat na chaahau man preet charan kamalaare ||
english_translation: I do not desire power, and I do not desire liberation; my mind is in love with Your lotus feet.

gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
romanization: anik jatan kar raakhau manooaa ||
english_translation: In many ways, I try to hold my mind steady.

gurmukhi: ਅਲਹੁ ਵੈਰੀ ਅਲਹੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
romanization: alahu vairee alahu meet ||
english_translation: The Lord is his enemy, and the Lord is his friend.

gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
romanization: sagal samagree teree dhaaree ||
english_translation: All things are supported by You.

gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਨਹਾਰ ॥
romanization: lekhai katahi na chhooteeai khinu khinu bhoolanahaar ||
english_translation: By your account, I can never be saved; each and every moment, I am a sinner.

gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ॥
romanization: maran likhaai mandal mahi aae ||
english_translation: Death is pre-ordained for all who come into this world.

gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
romanization: dukhu visaarahu sukhu leeijai ||
english_translation: Forget your suffering and take hold of peace.

gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
romanization: balu chhutakio bandhan pare kachhoo na hot upaai ||
english_translation: My strength is exhausted, and I am in bonds; I cannot do anything at all.

gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
romanization: gur binu ghor andhaar ||
english_translation: Without the Guru, there is pitch darkness.
